info.description: Idempotency ledger for /api/webhooks/stripe — one row per processed Stripe event.id. A unique-constraint conflict on eventId at creation time is how the handler detects a redelivery and skips re-running side effects, instead of an in-memory cache that wouldn't survive a restart or multiple instances.

resolved.description: False when no tenant could be resolved for this event (logged for visibility, not retried — see the webhook handler's own comment).
